# World drawing: assets

`cinnabar:world-draw/assets@0.2.0`

Reads only immutable package files verified by the host, without filesystem access.

**Grants:** `world_draw`; only this component's verified package files are readable.

Imported type `draw-error`: [`draw-error`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-draw-error).
